title: Proper/open comparison for pro-etale module sheaves
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $p:V\to T$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], let $i:W\hookrightarrow T$ be an arbitrary open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and put $U=V\times_TW$, with projections $k:U\hookrightarrow V$ and $r:U\to W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use sheaves of modules over the constant sheaves of rings $A_H$ on the small pro-etale sites of $H=U,V,W,T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $p_*,r_*$ and $i^*,k^*$ for direct image and exact inverse image with constant-ring identifications [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and $i_!,k_!$ for extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero].
For a module sheaf $M$ on $U$, let
$$\lambda_M:i^*p_*k_!M\xrightarrow{\sim}r_*k^*k_!M\xrightarrow{\sim}r_*M$$
be open restriction followed by the inverse of the open unit. Open restriction is the identification given, on a pro-etale $Q\to W$, by evaluating both sides on $V\times_TQ=U\times_WQ$. Let
$$\gamma_M=\varepsilon_{i,p_*k_!M}\circ i_!(\lambda_M^{-1}):i_!r_*M\longrightarrow p_*k_!M$$
be its transpose under $i_!\dashv i^*$ [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-adjunction]. Then $\gamma_M$ is an isomorphism, natural in $M$. There is no quasi-compactness hypothesis on $i$, no boundedness condition, and no etale-origin condition on $M$.

proof.text: The affine specialization-localization argument in Steps 2--11 proves the counit component is an isomorphism for every module sheaf M. We record this strictly simpler componentwise support assertion as sfProperOpenCounit_isIso; its proof uses the sectionwise zero-extension description, exact module sheafification, pro-etale localization and proper closedness, the finite principal-open localization covers, and the specialization-zero theorem.

source.place: Tags 09AE, 09AG, 09AH and 096V; affine specialization-localization support argument

proof.text: For each module M, the delivered comparison component is the composite of the image under sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero of the inverse of the already-defined isomorphism sfProperOpenLambda and the counit component at p_* k_! M. The first factor is invertible by functoriality of isomorphisms, and the second by sfProperOpenCounit_isIso. Hence every component is an isomorphism, and NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app gives the asserted natural-transformation isomorphism.

split_report.summary: Preserved the entire statement, including arbitrary open immersions and arbitrary finite-coefficient pro-etale module sheaves. Proved the normalized open-adjunction map monic, proved the quasi-compact-open case on specialization-localization covers using proper closedness and 09AG, then reduced any section to a quasi-compact subopen using finitely many local extension-presheaf representatives. Reused existing nodes throughout; no new nodes and no Mathlib leaves. No geometric-stalk conservativity or unrestricted derived proper base change used. Independent second reading supplied closed-immersion and open-factorization citations, made the affine-base instantiation explicit, and clarified the zero-representative edge case.
